name: reccenter-carry
description: Rec Center generic carry check: from the balcony spawn down the back stairs to the ground floor, SM64-grab the floor cone ([Cone], Tool + RigidbodyPickup only -> PlainTool), hold-walk and hold-jump with it, SM64-throw it (B) through the original TryThrowMainHandTool(player, velocity), walk to the nearest free carriable, grab it and Z-drop it. Read the mario-carry hold / thrown / thrown-track lines.
notes: Stairs and ground-floor waypoints are the reccenter-tour ones (live verified up to the ground floor box x -19.6..-9.8 z -9.9..-5.2, y 0.09; route reccenter-tour 20261008T041115Z).

Carriables read offline from level6 (scene6) Tool objects: [Cone] (-7.35,0.34,-3.70) and [Cone] (1) (-7.37,0.34,-2.66), components Rigidbody + Tool + RigidbodyPickup + ToolEntity only (CarryPolicy PlainTool); [TrashCan_Office] (-5.86,0.32,-3.90); a [WaterJug] stands at (-8.03,1.27,-4.76) on furniture. The floor around x -8 z -3.7 (east of the verified box) is NOT verified live; a stuck result there is logged and the route continues.

Expected (not verified live): `mario-carry Pickup` for the cone, then `mario-carry hold ... kind=PlainTool orientation=upright-facing-yaw ... err~0 rootToTarget small holderMode=cycle|getter` every 30 ticks (the cone's collider-bounds bottom centre at the SM64 HOLP, upright, facing Mario's yaw); `mario-carry thrown tool=... vel=-7.500,6.000,0.000 speed=9.605 ... returned=True held=False` after the throw facing yaw 270 (-X), then `mario-carry thrown-track` lines (the original physics flight) until it rests; the final Z drop is the original TryDropMainHandTool.

SM64 grab rule: B (punch) while the offered proxy cylinder overlaps Mario and lies within +-60 deg of his facing (interact_grabbable / able_to_grab_object); the cone proxy radius is its collider extents, so Mario stands ~0.6 m from it.
Launch: Rec Center (no quest), -MarioFollow -MarioCarry with the route drive / world input / route the helper always adds.

steps.text: reccenter-carry: balcony spawn, heading for the back stairs
ground floor (expect y about 0.09); walking to the floor cone
holding the cone: standing still (mario-carry hold lines; expect err~0, the cone upright at the HOLP)
SM64 throw (B) toward -X: original TryThrowMainHandTool with the SM64 throw velocity
walking to the nearest free carriable (expect the thrown cone)
